metadata.description: Open-source, governed legal workflow plugins maintained by l0cka.

plugins.name: australian-legislation
plugins.description: Verify Commonwealth, State and Territory legislation and trace Commonwealth legislative change against official Australian sources.

plugins.name: legal-triage
plugins.description: Configure and conduct governed, staff-facing legal enquiry triage for Australian community legal centres.

plugins.name: australian-privacy-cybersecurity
plugins.description: Route and verify Australian privacy, cyber incident, statutory tort, automated-decision and AI-use-case issues using current legislation.

plugins.name: australian-case-law
plugins.description: Verify Australian case citations, judgments and quoted passages against the official court publishers, flagging citations that cannot be found as fabrication risks.

plugins.name: australian-legal-citation
plugins.description: Draft, convert, review and correct Australian legal citations and bibliographies in Australian Guide to Legal Citation, 4th edition (AGLC4) format.
